levels.name: Apprentice
levels.privilege: can upload torrents;  can access forums;  can make bookmarks;  can create collages;  can use the notifications system;  can create polls in the forums;  can bump threads in the forums;  can set forum signature (up to 128 characters);  can access site statistics

levels.name: User
levels.privilege: can use upload templates;  can add and vote on tags;  can add multiple tags at once

levels.name: Power User
levels.privilege: can access top 10 lists;  can create and vote in Requests;  can set torrent footer (800 px);  can set forum signature (up to 256 characters)

levels.name: Super User
levels.privilege: can download zips of torrent files (from collages, and user pages);  can create public upload templates;  can set forum signature (up to 512 characters)

levels.name: Fapinator
levels.privilege: can set forum signature (up to 1024 characters)
